evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Improve consistency, quality and governance across reporting and analytics
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities emphasize governance, standards, quality and best practice with no velocity/speed language present.
evidence.domain_risk: help define how data and analytics should be used to support better decision making
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors affect business decision-making via reporting/dashboards without explicit regulatory or financial-reporting consequence, so moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Establish scalable standards and processes as the analytics capability develops
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: JD explicitly frames the analytics capability as still developing/scaling with the candidate defining standards from scratch, indicating an early-stage function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Build insightful Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions. Use SQL and other analytical tools to interrogate and analyse data.
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Named tools (Power BI, SQL) with precise application context and specific responsibilities like KPI framework development make this hiring-manager-authored, despite agency posting.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Take ownership of the approach to analytics and business intelligence
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Primary framing is establishing and owning the internal analytics/BI capability itself rather than a specific commercial/product/finance function.
evidence.autonomy_level: Take ownership of the approach to analytics and business intelligence. Establish scalable standards and processes as the analytics capability develops.
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Strategic verbs dominate throughout (take ownership, define, establish, challenge, shape the longer term direction) with the candidate setting direction for the analytics function.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tool usage or AI-data-infrastructure expectation is mentioned anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: Improve consistency, quality and governance across reporting and analytics
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality/governance is named as a responsibility but without explicit testing tooling or a dedicated testing ownership verb, so tool_listed.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Improve consistency, quality and governance across reporting and analytics
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Quality and governance are named responsibilities but secondary to the JD's dominant framing around shaping strategy and challenging existing approaches, so moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Review existing reporting and identify opportunities to improve how data and insight are used
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: JD mixes reviewing/improving existing reporting with establishing new standards and processes, so mixed.
evidence.loss_aversion: Improve consistency, quality and governance across reporting and analytics — governance framed as a named but secondary responsibility alongside strategic capability-building.
